text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 15.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #1a1a1a

g.text: AI took most of the world's packaging and memory, and a tenth of its logic

text.style: font-size: 10.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: What it shows: the share of world supply the four tracked designers took across the whole window, against the share they

text.style: font-size: 10.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: took in Q4 2025 alone. The published figure and CHIP-D01 both answer the second question quarter by quarter; only Epoch's

text.style: font-size: 10.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: cumulative file answers the first, and it is the one a capacity question actually asks.

text.style: font-size: 8.6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: Source: Epoch AI, AI Chip Components (CC-BY) — cumulative_supply_denominators.csv + supply_denominators.csv — epoch.ai/data/ai-chip-

text.style: font-size: 8.6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: components

text.style: font-size: 8.6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: Methodology: Derivation follows Epoch AI's published AI Chip Components methodology; every figure is a Monte Carlo median over 10,000 draws

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: Note: Cumulative share is everything the tracked designers consumed from Q1 2024 to Q4 2025 over everything the world produced in the same

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: window - not an average of the quarterly shares, which would weight a small quarter like a large one. The gap between the two bars is

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: the direction of travel: HBM at 81% cumulative against 97% in the final quarter is concentration still building, while logic sits

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: near a tenth of supply on both measures. Epoch's "Other" designer row is excluded from the numerator throughout: it is the residual

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: of the denominator, so including it returns 100% by construction. Every value is a Monte Carlo median.
